mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xl_aa_bill (team_id, name, total_amount, member_count, per_person_amount, status, creator_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{name}, #{totalAmount}, #{memberCount}, #{perPersonAmount}, #{status}, #{creatorId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM xl_aa_bill WHERE team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE xl_aa_bill SET name = #{name}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, member_count = #{memberCount}, per_person_amount = #{perPersonAmount}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM xl_aa_bill ORDER BY create_time DESC
